description: This file is a Perl test script using Test2::V0 and Test::Coocook modules to perform functional testing of a web application's organization lifecycle features, including creation, deletion, role management, and ownership transfer.

classes.name: Test::Coocook
classes.description: A testing class providing methods to simulate user interactions and verify web application behavior.

methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Test::Coocook object.
